title: Not Your Typical Sycophant: The Elusive Nature of Sycophancy in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the model's tendency to agree with the user by framing factual questions (from TruthfulQA) as a zero-sum bet between the user and a third party (a friend), and calculating the statistical deviation in favoring the user's proposed answer.

Evaluating the model's preference for an answer based on its position in the prompt (primacy or recency bias) by systematically flipping the order of the candidate answers in a neutral betting scenario.
